title: Coerce config values to the default's type
prompt: readConfig returns strings for everything. Coerce env values to the type of the default: numbers via Number (throw an Error naming the key when not a finite number), booleans from true/false/1/0/yes/no (case-insensitive, throw on anything else), strings unchanged.
acceptance: Invalid values throw an Error that names the key
Missing keys still use the default
